section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Cross-sectional view of differential showing side washer placement and ring gear assembly

content.text: (k) If not within specification, adjust by either increasing or decreasing the number of washers on both sides by an equal amount.
NOTE: There should be no clearance between the plate washer and case. Insure that there is ring gear backlash.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of ring gear teeth plate washer with side washer highlighted

content.text: (a) After adjustment with the backlash as referenced, remove the ring gear teeth plate washer and measure the thickness.

content.description: Illustration showing installation or tapping of side washer into differential housing

content.text: (b) Install a new washer of 0.06 ~ 0.09 mm (0.0024 ~ 0.0035 in.) thicker than the washer removed.
NOTE: Select a washer which can be pressed in 2/3 of the way by finger.
(c) Using a plastic hammer, tap in the side washer.

content.description: Cross-sectional view showing side washer and differential assembly for backlash check

content.text: (e) If not within standard, adjust by either increasing or decreasing the washers on both sides by equal amount.
NOTE: The backlash will change about 0.02 mm (0.0008 in.) with 0.03 mm (0.0012 in.) alteration of the side washers.

content.description: Cross-sectional view of differential showing final side washer placement on both sides
